questions.text: From which city did the renowned Sufi poet Abdur Rahman Momand hail?
questions.explanation: The renowned Sufi poet Abdur Rahman Momand hailed from Peshawar. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/abdur-rahman-momand).

questions.text: During which era did Abdur Rahman Momand gain prominence as a Sufi poet?
questions.explanation: Abdur Rahman Momand gained prominence as a Sufi poet during the Mughal era. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/abdur-rahman-momand).

questions.text: Abdur Rahman Momand is considered among the most popular poets of which language?
questions.explanation: Abdur Rahman Momand, also known as Rahman Baba, is considered among the most popular poets of Pashto. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/abdur-rahman-momand).

questions.text: In which language did Ali bin Usman Al-Hajveri write his famous book Kashf-al-Mahjub?
questions.explanation: Ali bin Usman Al-Hajveri wrote his famous book Kashf-al-Mahjub in Persian. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/ali-bin-usman-al-hajveri).

questions.text: Ali bin Usman Al-Hajveri was born in which empire?
questions.explanation: Ali bin Usman Al-Hajveri, famously known as Data Ganj Bakhsh, was born in the Ghaznavid Empire. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/ali-bin-usman-al-hajveri).

questions.text: Who is the author of 'Kashaf-ul-Mahjoob'?
questions.explanation: The author of 'Kashaf-ul-Mahjoob' is Ali bin Usman Al-Hajveri. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/ali-bin-usman-al-hajveri).

questions.text: What is the famous Persian tribute quoted by Moin uddin Chishti for Ali bin Usman Al-Hajveri?

options.A: Ganj Bakhsh Faiz-e-Alam Mazhar-e-Noor-e-Khuda, Naqisan ra peer-e-kamil, kamlan ra rahnuma
options.B: Hast darveshi ba zair-e-dilq Haidar (RA) mastur, Shahbaz-e-be-nishan o be-nishan amad ba khak
options.C: Khusro ra badshah-e-Hind o Hunud, Khizr ra sultan-e-aab o khak o bud
options.D: Chashm-e-bad door, cheh khush guft Khuda rahmat kunad in ra

questions.explanation: Moin uddin Chishti paid tribute to Ali bin Usman Al-Hajveri with the famous Persian couplet: "Ganj Bakhsh Faiz-e-Alam Mazhar-e-Noor-e-Khuda, Naqisan ra peer-e-kamil, kamlan ra rahnuma". Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/ali-bin-usman-al-hajveri).

questions.text: What is the name of Ali bin Usman Al-Hajveri's tomb-shrine in Lahore?
questions.explanation: The tomb-shrine of Ali bin Usman Al-Hajveri in Lahore is called Data Darbar. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/ali-bin-usman-al-hajveri).

questions.text: What is the real name of the Sufi saint popularly known as Data Gunj Bukhsh?

options.A: Abu-al Hasan Ali bin Usman Al-Hajveri

questions.explanation: The real name of Data Gunj Bukhsh is Abu-al Hasan Ali bin Usman Al-Hajveri. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/ali-bin-usman-al-hajveri).

questions.text: Amir Khusro was the disciple of ?
questions.explanation: Amir Khusro was the disciple of Hazrat Nizamuddin (Nizam-ud-Din Auliya). Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/amir-khusro) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: Who is regarded as the 'father of qawwali' in the Indian subcontinent?
questions.explanation: Amir Khusro is regarded as the 'father of qawwali' in the Indian subcontinent. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/amir-khusro).

questions.text: Who was Amir Khusro?
questions.explanation: Amir Khusro was a versatile genius who was a poet, a musician, and a scholar — all of these. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/amir-khusro).

questions.text: Who is also buried at the Nizamuddin Dargah besides Nizamuddin Auliya?
questions.explanation: The famous Sufi poet and disciple Amir Khusro is also buried at the Nizamuddin Dargah in Delhi, near his spiritual master Nizamuddin Auliya. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/amir-khusro).

questions.text: By which nickname is Amir Khusro sometimes referred to?
questions.explanation: Amir Khusro is famously referred to by the nickname Tuti-e-Hind (Parrot of India). Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/amir-khusro).

questions.text: In which language did Amir Khusro primarily write his poetry?
questions.explanation: Corrected key: Amir Khusro wrote primarily in Persian (he also composed in Hindavi, the precursor of Urdu). The source key (Rekhta/Urdu) was wrong. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/amir-khusro).

questions.text: What was the full name of Amir Khusro?

options.B: Abu'l Fath Jalal ud-Din Muhammad Akbar
options.D: Abu'l Qasim Mansur ibn Hasan Khusrau

questions.explanation: The full name of Amir Khusro is Abu'l Hasan Yamīn ud-Din Khusrau. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/amir-khusro).

questions.text: During which period did Amir Khusro live?
questions.explanation: Amir Khusro lived during the Delhi Sultanate period. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/amir-khusro).

questions.text: Wazir Khan Mosque is located in _?
questions.explanation: Wazir Khan Mosque is located in Lahore, Pakistan. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/arts-architecture-heritage-sites) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: Who was Zia Mohyeddin?
questions.explanation: Zia Mohyeddin was a renowned Pakistani actor, broadcaster, and director known for his work in television, theatre, and film. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/arts-architecture-heritage-sites) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: What is the name of the famous fort located in Hunza other than Altit fort?
questions.explanation: The famous fort located in Hunza other than Altit Fort is Baltit Fort. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/arts-architecture-heritage-sites).

questions.text: The Tomb of Shah Shams is located in which city?
questions.explanation: The Tomb of Shah Shams is located in Multan, famously known as the City of Saints. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/arts-architecture-heritage-sites).

questions.text: How long did it take to build the Minar-e-Pakistan?
questions.explanation: The construction of Minar-e-Pakistan took 8 years, from 1960 to 1968. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/arts-architecture-heritage-sites).

questions.text: Kafir Fort is located in the Province _?
questions.explanation: Kafir Fort is located in the province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/arts-architecture-heritage-sites).

questions.text: Hansraj, the pet antelope of Prince Salim is buried at ?
questions.explanation: Hansraj, the pet antelope of Prince Salim (later Emperor Jahangir), is buried at Hiran Minar in Sheikhupura. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/arts-architecture-heritage-sites).

questions.text: Where is Pakistan National Council of Arts located in Pakistan?
questions.explanation: The Pakistan National Council of Arts (PNCA) is located in Islamabad, the federal capital of Pakistan. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/arts-architecture-heritage-sites).

questions.text: Where is the shrine of Bahauddin Zakariya located?
questions.explanation: The shrine of Bahauddin Zakariya is located in Multan, Pakistan. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/bahauddin-zakariya).

questions.text: What is the modern name of the town where Bahauddin Zakariya was born?
questions.explanation: The modern name of the town where Bahauddin Zakariya was born is Karor Lal Esan. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/bahauddin-zakariya).

questions.text: Where is Bahauddin Zakariya University located?
questions.explanation: Bahauddin Zakariya University is located in Multan, Punjab, Pakistan. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/bahauddin-zakariya).

questions.text: Who was the grandfather and spiritual predecessor of Shah Rukn-e-Alam?
questions.explanation: The grandfather and spiritual predecessor of Shah Rukn-e-Alam was Sheikh Bahauddin Zakariya. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/bahauddin-zakariya).

questions.text: Which Sufi order was Bahauddin Zakariya associated with?
questions.explanation: Bahauddin Zakariya was associated with the Suhrawardiyya Order of Sufism. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/bahauddin-zakariya).

questions.text: Which Sufi saint did Lal Shahbaz Qalandar meet in Multan who belonged to the Suhrawardiyya order?
questions.explanation: Lal Shahbaz Qalandar met Baha-ud-din Zakariya in Multan, who was a prominent saint of the Suhrawardiyya order. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/bahauddin-zakariya).

questions.text: Which city is known as the City of Saints?
questions.explanation: Multan is famously known as the City of Saints due to its rich Sufi heritage and the numerous shrines of revered saints located there. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/bahauddin-zakariya).

questions.text: Where is the shrine of Bulleh Shah located?
questions.explanation: The shrine of Bulleh Shah is located in Kasur, Punjab, Pakistan. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/bulleh-shah).

questions.text: Which poetic form did Bulleh Shah primarily use in his works?
questions.explanation: Bulleh Shah primarily used the Kafi poetic form in his works. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/bulleh-shah).

questions.text: During which era did Bulleh Shah live and write his poetry?
questions.explanation: Bulleh Shah lived and wrote his poetry during the Mughal era. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/bulleh-shah).

questions.text: Who was the spiritual teacher (murshad) of Bulleh Shah?
questions.explanation: The spiritual teacher (murshad) of Bulleh Shah was Hazrat Shah Inayat Qadiri. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/bulleh-shah).

questions.text: What is the real name of the poet popularly known as Bulleh Shah?
questions.explanation: The real name of the poet popularly known as Bulleh Shah is Syed Abdullah Shah Qadri. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/bulleh-shah).

questions.text: In which language did Bulleh Shah primarily compose his poetry?
questions.explanation: Bulleh Shah primarily composed his poetry in Punjabi. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/bulleh-shah).

questions.text: To which Sufi order did Baba Farid belong?
questions.explanation: Baba Farid belonged to the Chishti Sufi order. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/fariduddin-masud-gunj-shakar) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: Where did Baba Farid receive his early education?
questions.explanation: Baba Farid received his early education in Multan. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/fariduddin-masud-gunj-shakar).

questions.text: Who was Baba Farid's teacher?
questions.explanation: Baba Farid's teacher (spiritual mentor) was Qutab-ud-Din Bakhtiar Kaki. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/fariduddin-masud-gunj-shakar).

questions.text: What is the full name of the Sufi saint known as Baba Farid?
questions.explanation: The full name of the Sufi saint known as Baba Farid is Farid-ud-Din Masud Ganjshakar. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/fariduddin-masud-gunj-shakar).

questions.text: Baba Fareed Shaker Ganj was the first poet of:
questions.explanation: Baba Fareed Shaker Ganj was the first poet of Punjabi. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/fariduddin-masud-gunj-shakar).

questions.text: Where is the Shrine of Hazrat Baba Farid located?
questions.explanation: The Shrine of Hazrat Baba Farid is located in Pakpattan, Punjab, Pakistan. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/fariduddin-masud-gunj-shakar).

questions.text: In which Sikh scripture is Baba Farid's poetry included?
questions.explanation: Baba Farid's poetry is included in the Guru Granth Sahib, the holy scripture of Sikhism. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/fariduddin-masud-gunj-shakar).

questions.text: What was Habba Khatoon also known as?
questions.explanation: Habba Khatoon was also known as Zoon Rather. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/habba-khatoon).

questions.text: In which century did Habba Khatoon live?
questions.explanation: Habba Khatoon lived in the 16th century. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/habba-khatoon).

questions.text: Who was the husband of Habba Khatoon?
questions.explanation: Habba Khatoon was married to King Yusuf Shah Chak, the last independent ruler of Kashmir. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/habba-khatoon).

questions.text: Where was Khawaja Ghulam Farid born?
questions.explanation: Khawaja Ghulam Farid was born in Chachran Town, located in the Khanpur tehsil of Rahim Yar Khan district, Punjab, Pakistan. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/khawaja-ghulam-farid).

questions.text: Which of the following languages did Khawaja Ghulam Farid master?
questions.explanation: Khawaja Ghulam Farid mastered All of these languages — Arabic, Persian, and Saraiki, among others. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/khawaja-ghulam-farid).

questions.text: When did Khawaja Ghulam Farid die?
questions.explanation: Khawaja Ghulam Farid, the great Sufi poet of the Chishti order, died in 1901. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/khawaja-ghulam-farid).

questions.text: Khushal Khan Khattak was a famous poet of language.
questions.explanation: Khushal Khan Khattak was a famous poet of the Pashto language. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/khushal-khan-khattak) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: What did Khushal Khan Khattak preach to the Pashtuns?

options.C: Union of Pashtuns against the Mughal Empire

questions.explanation: Khushal Khan Khattak preached the union of Pashtuns against the Mughal Empire. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/khushal-khan-khattak).

questions.text: With which empire did Khushal Khan Khattak initially have an alliance?
questions.explanation: Khushal Khan Khattak initially had an alliance with the Mughal Empire. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/khushal-khan-khattak).

questions.text: Who is considered the 'father of Pashto literature'?
questions.explanation: Khushal Khan Khattak is regarded as the father of Pashto literature. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/khushal-khan-khattak).

questions.text: Where was Khushal Khan Khattak born?
questions.explanation: Khushal Khan Khattak was born in Akora, Nowshera District (present-day Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan). Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/khushal-khan-khattak).

questions.text: Who is recognized as the national poet of Afghanistan?
questions.explanation: Khushal Khan Khattak is recognized as the national poet of Afghanistan. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/khushal-khan-khattak).

questions.text: Who was a contemporary of Abdur Rahman Momand and is also considered one of the most popular Pashto poets?
questions.explanation: The contemporary of Abdur Rahman Momand and one of the most popular Pashto poets is Khushal Khan Khattak. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/khushal-khan-khattak).

questions.text: On which date did Sindh announce Sindhi as its official language?
questions.explanation: Sindh announced Sindhi as its official language on 7 July 1972 through the Sindh Assembly. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/languages-of-pakistan) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: At which university has the Sindhiology department been established?
questions.explanation: The Sindhiology department has been established at the University of Sindh, Jamshoro. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/languages-of-pakistan) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: Pashto is the provincial language of
questions.explanation: Pashto is the provincial language of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa (KPK). Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/languages-of-pakistan).

questions.text: The Sindhi language is based on?
